assets.name: Ashlar Wall
assets.description: 4 m bays with bonded drip courses, stepped plinth and coping. Origin at the base center.

evidence.art: Repeated straight runs need corners/returns and repair variants; the face pattern reads uniform at gameplay scale.
evidence.godot: Imported within Gate Terrace pilot on the supported Hollowmark checkout.

assets.name: Vaulted Gateway
assets.description: 2.68 m clear opening. Full-depth voussoirs, jambs and radial mouldings. Origin at threshold center.

evidence.art: Full-depth voussoirs hold up technically. The relationship between the spandrel, engaged jamb and coping needs a stronger silhouette and less visible separation.
evidence.godot: Imported within Gate Terrace pilot on the supported Hollowmark checkout.

assets.name: Limestone Stair
assets.description: 3.6 m-wide route. Nine 0.18 m risers and 0.34 m treads. Origin at first riser.

evidence.art: Stepped route tested. Sidewalls and copings are too uniformly cut for the ruins benchmark and need terrain-fitting variants.
evidence.godot: Imported within Gate Terrace pilot on the supported Hollowmark checkout.

assets.name: Faulted Limestone Escarpment
assets.description: Irregular sedimentary ledge, exposed faults and apron. Local Z=0 at the foot.

evidence.art: Silhouette improves over stacked blocks but exposed facets and contact with paving still look artificial.
evidence.godot: Imported within Gate Terrace pilot on the supported Hollowmark checkout.

assets.name: Honed Limestone
assets.description: Image-backed pale cut-stone finish. 1.6 m UV repeat for architectural modules.

evidence.art: Albedo, GL normal and roughness survive import. The honed finish reads too uniform at oblique angles.
evidence.godot: Imported within Gate Terrace pilot on the supported Hollowmark checkout.

assets.name: Irregular Stone Court
assets.description: Continuous paved formation with staggered sett courses. Origin at center of walking plane.

evidence.art: Readable larger setts. Foundation joins and worn edge transitions need an additional structural pass.
evidence.godot: Imported within Gate Terrace pilot on the supported Hollowmark checkout.
